title: Awa Pit language
description: Barbacoan language of Colombia and Ecuador
extract: Awa Pit, otherwise known as Cuaiquer, is a Barbacoan language. Awa Pit is classified by UNESCO as a severely endangered language. The Awa Pit language has a subject–object–verb structure and has adopted the Latin script. Grammatically, Awa Pit uses a characteristic conjunct/disjunct system of verb suffixes for person-marking.
